category_note: No form category fits an invented UI. Closest is webpage (UI animation), used asset-free: the calendar is hand-built HTML, not a captured page, so the module's capture step does not apply. Catalog search ('calendar booking UI card slides into grid slot') found no calendar block; grid-card-assemble is the nearest primitive but is a stagger-assemble, not a persistent world. Hand-author.
style: Light, crisp, minimal calendar. One persistent weekly grid, never cut or reset. Exactly one element at full emphasis at a time; everything else quiet but legible. Plays once, holds last frame (no loop).
accent_rule: Amber only on (a) the travelling chip + a slot's first ~0.6s after landing, then it settles to surface, and (b) the final 'Off' block.
font: Inter Tight (labels, 600) + Inter (body, 500). Instrument Serif italic for the single word 'Off' only.

rail.note: One inbound card at a time, vertically centred. Chip paths start at the card's left edge.

slot_styles.open: white fill, 3px dashed #9C9A94 border, label 'Open' muted
slot_styles.cancelled: white fill, label 'Cancelled' muted with strike-through
slot_styles.new: #FFA524 fill, label 'Booked' ink; settles to booked style after 0.6s

scenes.motion: Grid fully present at frame 0 (no entrance). Dashed borders of the two open slots draw on 0.1-0.6s (stroke-dashoffset, cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)).

Card slides in from right 0.8-1.2 (x+60, cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)). 1.5: 'Answered' + check replaces muted '6:12 pm' (y-swap 0.3s). 1.7-2.3: amber chip 'Booked' leaves card along a drawn dotted arc to Tue 9 am (power2.inOut). 2.3 lands, slot amber; 2.9 settles to booked.
Call card exits up (0.25s power2.in) at 2.6; DM card enters 2.7-3.1. 3.3 'Replied' swaps in under '11:48 pm'. 3.4-4.0 chip travels to Wed 5 pm, lands 4.0, settles 4.6.

DM card exits 4.3. 4.5: Wed 12 pm flips rotateX 0->90->0 (0.4s) to 'Cancelled'. 4.9-5.3 Waitlist card enters, 'Next in line' + check. 5.5-6.0 chip travels to Wed 12 pm and drops in with back.out(1.6) (the only back.out). Settles 6.3.
Waitlist card exits 6.3. 6.5 rail shows muted 'Week full' (fade_in). 6.6-7.0 Off slot fills amber from bottom (scaleY, cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)), 'Off' goes ink + serif. 7.0-8.0 hold, static.

motion_rules: chips always travel a visible dotted path that draws ~0.15s ahead of the chip and fades after landing
no morphs, people, mascots, stats, chat bubbles; never the word 'AI'
content.final_frame: All 9 slots filled: 8 quiet 'Booked' (surface), Thu 5 pm amber 'Off'. Rail: muted 'Week full'. Doubles as poster + reduced-motion fallback.
content.social_cut_note: Reuse timeline and slot ids. 1920x1080: scale grid 1.5x, rail keeps right third. 1080x1350: rail becomes a strip under the grid, chip paths curve upward. Dark: bg #0A0A0B, surface #1A1A1C, border #2A2A2D, text #F4F2ED, amber unchanged. Slow push scale 1.0->1.06 over 8s (sine.inOut) on the grid container only.
